description: This file defines functions for converting QUIC error codes to strings, mapping error codes to transport error codes, and handling error code conversions for QUIC protocol, including specific handling for HTTP/3 and QPACK error codes.

classes.name: QuicResetStreamError
classes.description: Represents a QUIC reset stream error with methods to create instances from internal or IETF error codes.

methods.name: QuicRstStreamErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicRstStreamErrorCode to its string representation.

methods.name: QuicErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicErrorCode to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const QuicIetfTransportErrorCodes&)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a QuicIetfTransportErrorCodes to a stream.

methods.name: QuicErrorCodeToTransportErrorCode
methods.description: Maps a QuicErrorCode to its corresponding IETF transport error code.

methods.name: TlsAlertToQuicErrorCode
methods.description: Converts an SSL/TLS alert description to a QuicErrorCode.

methods.name: RstStreamErrorCodeToIetfResetStreamErrorCode
methods.description: Converts a QuicRstStreamErrorCode to an IETF QUIC reset stream error code.

methods.name: QuicResetStreamError::FromInternal
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from an internal QuicRstStreamErrorCode.

methods.name: QuicResetStreamError::FromIetf(uint64_t)
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from an IETF error code.

methods.name: QuicResetStreamError::FromIetf(QuicHttp3ErrorCode)
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from a QuicHttp3ErrorCode.

methods.name: QuicResetStreamError::FromIetf(QuicHttpQpackErrorCode)
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from a QuicHttpQpackErrorCode.
